title: Agent loop slot contract (contract in clossys/agents/<agent>/loop.<name>/slot.json)
description: Derived from src/loop/agent-loops.ts. The loop the slot holds the agent's own version of, the Producer standard loop it extends, and any extra requirements the agent adds. The steps themselves are the pinned candidate; the extension rules (required steps, exit checks, owner-class when data) are judged by the loop certifier and loop.agent-standard.
